reviews.text: I had my granny plug stripped out. Jesse did the work and did a great job. He is honest and that worth is priceless. I will definitely use Jesse in the future. I would highly recommend Jesse.
reviews.author: Mike Massey

reviews.text: Jesse is such a great mechanic! We have been going to him for almost 7 years and all I can say is that he is truly an honest, caring, hardworking mechanic. We are so thankful to have found him. If you go here, you definitely are in good hands:)
reviews.author: Bex Harris

reviews.text: Wish I could give more than 5 stars! Jesse is the best- I've trusted him with a handful of repairs and services for my car, and he does a stellar job every time! Townsend consistently delivers thorough and honest work, which can be very hard to come by. I'm so grateful to have a go-to shop with outstanding technicians I can always count on- thank you so much for all your hard work!
reviews.author: Brenna Burk

reviews.text: My partner and I go to Jesse for every issue we have with our vehicles. He is awesome. Honest and a good person all-around. I will always trust Townsend!
reviews.author: Andy Sommerville

reviews.text: Super kind and caring service. Very understanding and was able to help us out in a pinch. Highly recommend this place.
reviews.author: Milos Jovanovic
